El primer analizador de expresiones con: The first expression analyser with precedences was a real problem, not an exercise. The FORTRAN team, between 1954 and 1957, took two and a half years and used a method John Backus described as putting extra brackets around each operator, lots of them, and then removing them: it worked and nobody quite understood it. Recursive descent was distilled afterwards, with ALGOL, when it was seen that if the grammar was written in layers the analyser came out by itself. That a two-and-a-half-year problem should turn into twenty lines when the grammar is written properly is one of the best stories in computing.
